description: End an in-progress call immediately, identified by its call ID. Use this to hang up a call you started (or any active call in your account). Ending a call that has already finished is a no-op, so it is safe to retry. Returns the call's resulting status.

call_id.description: The ID of the call to end, from list_calls or a make_call / make_conversation_call response.

name: end_call

endedAt.description: When the call ended (ISO 8601), or null.

status.description: The call's resulting status after ending.

success.description: Whether the end request was accepted.

title: End Call
